payout_value_note: $25 to referrer per qualifying checking referral; $100 per qualifying loan-product referral. The referred friend receives the same reward. No cap stated.
payout_quote: Refer your friends or family to join WyHy and you'll both receive $25 for qualifying checking accounts and $100 for every qualifying loan product* they enroll in. ... There's no limit — refer as many new members as you can.
steps: Member refers a friend or family member to join WyHy (refer-a-friend link at wyhy.org).
Friend joins and opens a qualifying checking account (referrer earns $25) or enrolls in a qualifying loan product (referrer earns $100).
The referred friend receives the same reward.
catches: Evidence is announcement-style on the CU's official article page; the article does not publish full terms or define exactly which products are 'qualifying'.
No cap stated ('no limit'), but no per-referrer cap figure either.
Field of membership is Wyoming-focused (WyHy is Wyoming's credit union).
biggest_catch: The announcement gives no full terms and doesn't define 'qualifying' products — the payout tiers are concrete but the fine print is thin.
eligibility: WyHy membership; referred person must join as a new member.
timing: Referral ~5 min active; reward timing not stated in the announcement.
